name: Xinhua
text: The death toll from an attack on a church in Karak, Jordan, has risen to nine, and the king has pledged a firm response.

name: Le Monde
text: Israeli forces have displaced hundreds of families in Hebron following a deadly attack, and Prime Minister Netanyahu has announced a large-scale operation in the West Bank.

name: The Hindu
text: Houthi-run media report Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa that killed at least 11 people, including three in a house strike, after missiles were intercepted.

name: SCMP
text: Houthi media say Saudi strikes in Sanaa killed 11 people on Saturday, shortly after the coalition said it intercepted two Houthi missiles.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Saudi air defenses reportedly intercepted three missiles aimed at Riyadh, Taif and Yanbu.

name: France 24
text: Israeli forces have displaced about 1,200 Palestinians in Hebron following a deadly attack on soldiers, and the Palestinian Authority is urging international pressure on Israel.

name: Le Monde
text: Saudi forces carried out deadly airstrikes in Yemen, as the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi missiles aimed at Taif and Yanbu.
